answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 152750 Country: India Title: I told in anger to my wife that go to your father home. After 2 days we again live together with love and did intercourse. Is the intercourse zina or it is right? Question: I told in anger to my wife that go to your father home. After 2 days we again live together with love and did intercourse. Is the intercourse zina or it is right? Answer ID: 152750 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1081/1012/SD=11/1438) If you did not intend to divorce your wife by the sentence “go to your father home” then in such a case no talaq occurred on your wife. Thus it is not haram to have intercourse after uttering this sentence.(Fatwa: 1081/1012/SD=11/1438) If you did not intend to divorce your wife by the sentence “go to your father home” then in such a case no talaq occurred on your wife. Thus it is not haram to have intercourse after uttering this sentence. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
